svg.text: Mammoth Thrust — the player's ship, to scale
27 parts · 36 welds · 33.1 kg dry · 61.2 kg at launch (8.1 kg propellant, 20.0 kg slugs) · overall 5.60 m × 3.65 m
Geometry and masses read from the ship template in scenarios/thrust-1.json (identical in all Thrust levels), built by scripts/asteroidShip.ts with Thrust's tuning in scripts/thrust.ts.
Origin = cockpit centroid; +y = forward (nose up). Sizes are each part's bounding box, width × height.

svg.text: centre of mass at launch (0.00, 0.01) m
tractor beam, 30° wedge (40 m range; drawn short)
8.10 kg propellant (0.90 H₂ + 7.20 O₂) + 20.00 kg slugs
• Not drawn: the shield's field, a 2 kg body that exists only while the shield is up — radius 4.45 m round the dry centre of mass; it adds 2 kg then.
• Engines hold no propellant at rest (their 20 ms chamber store fills when firing). Each tank feeds its own wing's two small thrusters, and both tanks feed the main thruster.
• Thrust: main 7.776 kg/s propellant flow; small thrusters 1.45 kg/s each. Railgun: 144 m/s, one slug every 0.125 s. Tether 12 m. Pod 34 kg (not part of the ship).
• Mass rule: a body's mass = its dry mass + its stores + shells in its magazine (src/core/bodies.ts, bodyMass). The design doc's 69 kg predates halving the fuel load (thrust.ts: fuel 0.5).
